name: lago-billing
description: A billing engineer copilot that designs, implements, validates, migrates, and troubleshoots Lago billing in new or existing applications. Offline work needs no Lago credentials.

interface.shortDescription: Billing engineer copilot for new or existing applications.
interface.longDescription: Open an application repository, with or without billing code. The copilot inspects the stack, identifies whether billing already exists, and designs or improves the Lago integration. Offline work needs no Lago credentials or MCP connection; live sandbox validation needs Lago access, and production actions require separate approval.
defaultPrompt: Implement Lago in the application currently open in this workspace. First confirm the repository, explain what you can do offline, inspect the existing architecture, and ask only for blocking decisions.
